name: bunon-video
description: Bunon SaaS demo video (Remotion). Separate from the website build.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts BunonDemo out/bunon-demo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:voice: remotion render src/index.ts BunonDemo out/bunon-demo-voice.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --props=props-voice.json
scripts.render:clean: remotion render src/index.ts BunonDemoClean out/bunon-demo-clean.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
